summary: Executed backend + frontend regression for revised pricing, portfolio expected signals, expanded stock F&O output, and core login/admin/custom-position flows. Functional coverage passed; one hover readability design regression observed in Admin table action controls.

design_issues.screen: Admin page user table (row hover state)
issues: Global hover rule forces dark text on all descendants; inside dark action buttons (e.g., Update Credits), text contrast becomes very low and hard to read.

action_items: Adjust hover CSS specificity so button text inside hovered result rows remains readable (exclude button descendants or define button text color override).
Keep iteration-8 pricing/portfolio contract tests in CI regression suite.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py remains a 2200+ line monolith (>700 guideline) and should be split into auth/admin/fno/portfolio modules to reduce regression risk and improve maintainability.
FastAPI shutdown event uses deprecated on_event API; migrate to lifespan handlers.
Broad CSS selector '.result-hover:hover *' is high-risk and caused contrast regression in nested controls.
seed_data_creation: Temporary users/custom positions created during tests; pytest cleanup removed API-created test users. UI run also created/deleted a temporary user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 18 backend tests passed on public endpoint. Pricing observed: multibagger=2, fno=2, custom-position=1, portfolio=0.2 x parsed_positions_count with credit delta matching expected spend. F&O UI generated 16 stock cards and 4 top trades in this run.
rca of the issue: Design RCA: App.css hover rule '.result-hover:hover * { color: var(--hoverTextSafeColor)!important; }' overrides child button typography indiscriminately. When row background changes but button background stays dark, text becomes dark-on-dark and unreadable. Mitigation: scope hover text override to non-interactive descendants or set explicit contrasting button text color on row hover.
